final_text: The single queued spec, **dds_250msps** (NCO/DDS sin-cos for a digital up-converter, ≥250 MSPS, max_abs_err ≤ 2^-13, minimise LUTs, maximise accuracy_bits), is finalized. Memory was switched off, so `recall` returned nothing and `remember` stored nothing. L1 `run_dse` spent the entire 400-eval budget (inner graph: map_front → refine → map_front → stop) and yielded a 35-design feasible, non-dominated front, all from the pipelined family; the min-luts selection is `pipelined:data_width=17,n_iter=15,angle_guard=3,frac_guard=2,rounding=round` with luts=985 (estimate, M1-calibrated cost model), ffs=978 (estimate), throughput_msps=264 (estimate, meets the ≥250 constraint), accuracy_bits=13.4, and max_abs_err=9.31e-05 = 2^-13.39 (exact, golden model — meets the ≤2^-13 constraint). L2 `simulate_system` found no system scenario, so the selection was unchanged, but it did supply simulated DDS facts for the selection (SFDR 98.2 dBc, SNR 88.1 dB, 32-bit phase accumulator, coherent 16384-point FFT at tone bin 1297). The L3/L4/L5 ladder (run via the `ladder` sub-agent) added no new evidence: `verify_rtl` had no recorded row for this selection (a fresh exhaustive W=17 run is too heavy for a live campaign), `synthesize` had no recorded synthesis row (L4 is never run live), and `back_annotate` returned `no_measured_data` with no winner change — so `reexplore` was correctly not triggered, and the spec was closed on the L1/L2 selection.
